description: Set the width (in pixels) of one or more columns in a sheet. Indices are 0-based and the interval is half-open [startColumn, endColumn) — to resize a single column at position 5, pass startColumn: 5, endColumn: 6.

account.description: Alias of the Google account to target. Optional — defaults to the session/global default account, or the sole authenticated account. Run manage_accounts list to see available aliases.

endColumn.description: 0-based end column index (exclusive); must be greater than startColumn

sheetId.description: Sheet ID (from getSpreadsheetInfo / listSheets). The default first sheet is usually 0.

name: setColumnWidth
